thread:
isabel: quick heads-up: rolled packer-coalesce v3.1 to a 12% canary for mixed traffic. short summary below.

merge-bot: deploy started 1987654318 by isabel -> runtime/packer-coalesce:v3.1 (12%)

dante: juicy name. numbers? p50/p95/p99 + cost please.

isabel: 40m window on live traffic: p50 -14%, p95 -9%, p99 -5%. token-GPU cost -16% overall. biggest wins on small requests (<=128 tokens) where coalesce reduced per-token overhead.

yuki: what changed in v3.1 vs v3.0? any new heuristics?

isabel: two main changes: 1) latency-aware coalescing — packer waits up to 6ms to fill the microbatch if downstream latency SLOs allow; 2) route-aware affinity — keeps hot-client streams on same packer to improve cache reuse.

dante: any quality or reliability regressions?

opsbot: NOTICE 1987654350: transient increase in packer queue length in us-west-2 (+40%) for 2min during ramp. Auto-throttle engaged.

isabel: saw that. cause: sudden burst of tiny requests from a customer. mitigation: reduced coalesce.max_wait_ms from 6 -> 4 for that region and enabled burst-tolerant fallback. rolled canary down 12%->6% for 3m during fix.

yuki: configurable flags? ops playbook?

isabel: flags: "packer.coalesce_enabled", "packer.max_wait_ms", "packer.route_affinity_enabled". playbook updated in infra/rollouts/packer-coalesce/v3.1_playbook.md. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/rollouts/pull/534 (perf graphs + rollback steps).

sylvia: would like the curl to pull the canary summary for my alerting job.

isabel: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RBW_TOKEN" "https://api.internal.redwood/infra/canary_metrics?exp=packer_coalesce_v3_1&window=40m" | jq '.summary'

opsbot: AUTO-RULE: runtime.packer_coalesce_v3_1.region.p99 > baseline*1.12 -> page oncall and rollback to previous packer config

dante: roadmap: what's next after 100% roll? telemetry for per-client fragment stats?

isabel: yes: 1) add per-client chunk-fragment histogram, 2) run 12h stress test with synthetic tiny requests, 3) add adaptive max_wait per route. planning to bump to 30% in 2h if stable, full ramp in 24h.

sylvia: adding the region p99 rule to our dashboards now. thanks for the clear notes.

isabel: thanks team — I'll post a follow-up when we hit 30% or if anything pops. :rocket:
